Scene 1 - 0s:
Yellow astronaut stands in front of a large viewing window, chewing blue bubble gum and staring out at the glowing alien jellyfish-like organism floating outside.

Scene 2 - 1s:
Red astronaut enters the corridor, also chewing a piece of red bubble gum, and gives a friendly wave to Yellow.

Scene 3 - 2s:
Purple astronaut approaches Yellow and starts playing with his bubble gum, creating a big sticky mess on the floor.

Scene 4 - 3s:
Cyan astronaut walks into the corridor, blowing a huge bubble that looks like the logo of Galactic Gum Co., and smiles at Yellow and the others.

Scene 5 - 4s:
Yellow blows a giant bubble that engulfs the group, causing them all to laugh and playfully chase after it.

Scene 6 - 5s:
Red astronaut gets stuck in his own bubble gum, causing him to stumble and fall onto the floor.

Scene 7 - 6s:
Purple astronaut tries to help Red by using a tool to pop the bubble gum, but ends up getting tangled in the sticky mess himself.

Scene 8 - 7s:
Cyan astronaut jumps into the fray, blowing another giant bubble that envelops everyone, causing them all to giggle and play.

Scene 9 - 8s:
Yellow starts to get excited, chewing his blue bubble gum faster and faster, creating an even bigger bubble that takes over the corridor.

Scene 10 - 9s:
The group's bubbles start to combine, creating a massive colorful orb that fills the entire corridor.

Scene 11 - 10s:
Red astronaut gets caught in the combined bubble, causing him to spin around in circles with a huge grin on his face.

Scene 12 - 11s:
Purple astronaut tries to grab onto the bubble to steady himself, but ends up getting pulled into the center of the orb.

Scene 13 - 12s:
Cyan astronaut looks concerned as the bubble starts to grow and change shape, causing her to jump back in surprise.

Scene 14 - 13s:
Yellow's face lights up with excitement as he realizes his blue bubble gum is creating a massive, glowing galaxy inside the combined bubble.

Scene 15 - 14s:
The group stares in awe at the swirling colors of the galaxy within the bubble, causing them all to ooh and ahh in unison.

Scene 16 - 15s:
Yellow starts to blow another giant bubble, but this time it's filled with glittering space dust that makes everyone laugh.

Scene 17 - 16s:
Red astronaut gets covered in space dust, causing him to look like a human sparkly ornament.

Scene 18 - 17s:
Purple astronaut uses his tool to create a mini-explosion of colorful sparks within the bubble gum, causing everyone to giggle even harder.

Scene 19 - 18s:
Cyan astronaut tries to grab onto Yellow's blue bubble gum to steady herself, but ends up getting pulled into the center of the orb once again.

Scene 20 - 19s:
The combined bubbles start to merge, creating an enormous sphere that fills the entire corridor, causing everyone to cheer and clap.

Scene 21 - 20s:
Yellow blows one final giant bubble that engulfs everything, causing a massive, joyful explosion of color and light within the space.

Scene 22 - 21s:
The group emerges from the bubble, covered in sparkling space dust and grinning from ear to ear, as they all hug each other tightly.

Scene 23 - 22s:
Yellow proudly holds up his blue bubble gum, with a huge smile on his face, as he takes a triumphant bow to the camera.

Scene 24 - 23s:
The group cheers and applauds for Yellow, who is now standing in front of the glowing alien jellyfish-like organism, with the logo of Galactic Gum Co. shining brightly on the bubble gum.

Scene 25 - 24s:
Cyan astronaut hands Yellow a piece of pink bubble gum, as Red and Purple astronauts high-five each other behind her.

Scene 26 - 25s:
Yellow starts to chew his new pink bubble gum, creating a smaller but equally colorful sphere that floats in front of him.

Scene 27 - 26s:
The group's bubbles start to reappear, this time filled with different colors and flavors, causing them all to giggle and play again.

Scene 28 - 27s:
Yellow blows another giant bubble that engulfs the group, but this time it's filled with a message in glittering space dust that reads "Galactic Gum Co."

Scene 29 - 28s:
The group cheers as Yellow holds up his blue bubble gum, now surrounded by a halo of colorful sparks and light.

Scene 30 - 29s:
Yellow gives a final thumbs-up to the camera, as the screen fades to black with the sound of laughter and sparkling space dust still echoing in the background.
